CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_profession_pack(p_tenant uuid, p_profession_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  svc record;
begin
  for svc in select * from profession_services where profession_id = p_profession_id loop
    insert into services (tenant_id, name, duration_min, price_cents, cycle_days)
    values (p_tenant, svc.nome, svc.duracao_min, svc.preco_sugerido_cents, coalesce(svc.ciclo_dias, 21))
    on conflict do nothing;
  end loop;

  insert into business_hours (tenant_id, weekday, opens_at, closes_at)
  select p_tenant, d, '09:00'::time, case when d = 6 then '14:00'::time else '19:00'::time end
  from generate_series(1, 6) d
  on conflict do nothing;
end $function$

functions.name: apply_vertical_pack
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_vertical_pack(p_tenant uuid, p_vertical vertical_pack)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  pk record; item jsonb;
  svc_ids jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; prod_ids jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  new_id uuid;
begin
  select * into pk from vertical_packs where vertical = p_vertical;

  -- 'tattoo' e 'hair' existem no enum vertical_pack (0001) mas não têm pack
  -- semeado aqui — só 6 dos 8 valores têm catálogo pronto. Sem essa checagem,
  -- o onboarding de um tenant nessas duas verticais quebrava com 500 e a
  -- conta nunca chegava a existir. Sem pack, a conta nasce com catálogo vazio
  -- (a pessoa cadastra os serviços à mão, TICKET-016) em vez de travar o
  -- cadastro inteiro por uma lacuna de dado de negócio que não é do código.
  if found then
    -- serviços
    for item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(pk.services) loop
      insert into services (tenant_id, name, duration_min, price_cents, cycle_days,
                            deposit_bps, requires_anamnesis, buffer_after_min)
      values (p_tenant, item->>'name', (item->>'duration_min')::int, (item->>'price_cents')::bigint,
              greatest((item->>'cycle_days')::int, 1), (item->>'deposit_bps')::int,
              (item->>'requires_anamnesis')::boolean, coalesce((item->>'buffer_after_min')::int, 0))
      on conflict do nothing
      returning id into new_id;
      if new_id is not null then svc_ids := svc_ids || jsonb_build_object(item->>'name', new_id); end if;
    end loop;

    -- produtos
    for item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(pk.products) loop
      insert into products (tenant_id, name, unit, avg_cost_cents, reorder_point)
      values (p_tenant, item->>'name', item->>'unit', (item->>'avg_cost_cents')::bigint,
              (item->>'reorder_point')::numeric)
      on conflict do nothing
      returning id into new_id;
      if new_id is not null then prod_ids := prod_ids || jsonb_build_object(item->>'name', new_id); end if;
    end loop;

    -- ficha de consumo
    for item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(pk.consumption) loop
      if svc_ids ? (item->>'service') and prod_ids ? (item->>'product') then
        insert into service_products (tenant_id, service_id, product_id, qty)
        values (p_tenant, (svc_ids->>(item->>'service'))::uuid,
                (prod_ids->>(item->>'product'))::uuid, (item->>'qty')::numeric)
        on conflict do nothing;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end if;

  -- expediente padrão: seg-sex 9h-19h, sáb 9h-14h
  insert into business_hours (tenant_id, weekday, opens_at, closes_at)
  select p_tenant, d, '09:00'::time, case when d = 6 then '14:00'::time else '19:00'::time end
  from generate_series(1,6) d
  on conflict do nothing;
end $function$

functions.name: finish_job
functions.args: p_id bigint, p_status job_status, p_error text
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_job(p_id bigint, p_status job_status, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  update job_queue
  set status = p_status,
      last_error = coalesce(p_error, last_error),
      run_after = case when p_status = 'failed'
                       then now() + (least(60, power(2, attempts)) * interval '1 minute')
                       else run_after end,
      attempts = case when p_status in ('failed', 'dead') then attempts + 1 else attempts end
  where id = p_id;
$function$

functions.name: claim_jobs
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS SETOF job_queue
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  update job_queue
  set status = 'running',
      locked_at = now(),
      attempts = case when status = 'running' then attempts + 1 else attempts end,
      last_error = case when status = 'running'
                        then 'reivindicado por timeout: o worker anterior não terminou'
                        else last_error end
  where id in (
    select id from job_queue
    where (status in ('queued', 'failed') and run_after <= now())
       or (status = 'running' and locked_at < now() - interval '15 minutes' and attempts < max_attempts)
    order by run_after
    limit p_limit
    for update skip locked
  )
  returning *;
$function$

functions.args: p_key text, p_limite integer, p_janela_segundos integer
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consumir_rate_limit(p_key text, p_limite integer, p_janela_segundos integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(permitido boolean, restante integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_count int;
begin
  insert into public.rate_limits as r (key, count, expires_at)
  values (p_key, 1, now() + make_interval(secs => p_janela_segundos))
  on conflict (key) do update
     set count      = case when r.expires_at <= now() then 1 else r.count + 1 end,
         expires_at = case when r.expires_at <= now()
                           then now() + make_interval(secs => p_janela_segundos)
                           else r.expires_at end
  returning r.count into v_count;

  if v_count = 1 then
    delete from public.rate_limits
     where key in (
       select key from public.rate_limits
        where expires_at < now() - interval '1 hour'
        limit 50
     );
  end if;

  return query select v_count <= p_limite, greatest(0, p_limite - v_count);
end;
$function$

functions.name: fk_sem_indice_report
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fk_sem_indice_report()
 RETURNS TABLE(tabela text, constraint_name text, colunas text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with fk as (
    select c.conrelid::regclass::text as tabela,
           c.conname::text as constraint_name,
           array_agg(a.attname order by k.ord) as colunas
    from pg_constraint c
    join lateral unnest(c.conkey) with ordinality k(attnum, ord) on true
    join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = c.conrelid and a.attnum = k.attnum
    where c.contype = 'f' and c.connamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
    group by c.conrelid, c.conname
  ),
  idx as (
    select i.indrelid::regclass::text as tabela,
           (select array_agg(a.attname order by k.ord)
              from unnest(i.indkey::int[]) with ordinality k(attnum, ord)
              join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = i.indrelid and a.attnum = k.attnum) as colunas
    from pg_index i
  )
  select fk.tabela, fk.constraint_name, fk.colunas
  from fk
  where not exists (
    select 1 from idx
    where idx.tabela = fk.tabela
      and idx.colunas[1:array_length(fk.colunas, 1)] = fk.colunas
  )
  order by fk.tabela, fk.constraint_name;
$function$

SELECT c.id,
    c.tenant_id,
    c.name,
    c.phone_e164,
    c.phone_hash,
    c.email,
    c.birth_date,
    c.notes,
    c.tags,
    c.source,
    c.referred_by,
    c.marketing_opt_in,
    c.whatsapp_opt_out,
    c.no_show_count,
    c.visits_count,
    c.ltv_cents,
    c.last_visit_at,
    c.user_id,
    c.created_at,
    c.deleted_at,
    c.anonymized_at,
    c.preferences,
    c.document,
    c.gender,
    c.address,
    c.emergency_contact,
    c.preferred_professional_id,
    c.online_booking_blocked,
    c.name_busca,
    ((c.birth_date IS NOT NULL) AND (EXTRACT(month FROM c.birth_date) = EXTRACT(month FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE t.timezone))::date))) AS is_aniversariante,
    ((c.visits_count = 1) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM appointments a
          WHERE ((a.client_id = c.id) AND (a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::appointment_status, 'confirmed'::appointment_status, 'arrived'::appointment_status]))))))) AS is_primeira_visita_sem_retorno,
    ((c.visits_count > 0) AND (percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY c.tenant_id ORDER BY c.ltv_cents) >= (0.75)::double precision)) AS is_ticket_alto
   FROM (clients c
     JOIN tenants t ON ((t.id = c.tenant_id)))
  WHERE (c.deleted_at IS NULL);

views.name: v_carteira_resumo
views.def:
SELECT c.tenant_id,
    count(*) AS total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.created_at >= (date_trunc('month'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE t.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE t.timezone))) AS novos_mes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.visits_count > 1)) AS com_retorno,
    COALESCE(sum(c.ltv_cents), (0)::numeric) AS ltv_total,
    COALESCE(sum(c.visits_count), (0)::bigint) AS visitas_total
   FROM (clients c
     JOIN tenants t ON ((t.id = c.tenant_id)))
  WHERE (c.deleted_at IS NULL)
  GROUP BY c.tenant_id;

views.name: v_recover_revenue
views.def:
SELECT cc.tenant_id,
    cc.client_id,
    c.name AS client_name,
    c.phone_e164,
    cc.service_id,
    s.name AS service_name,
    cc.state,
    cc.late_days,
    cc.predicted_on,
    cc.value_at_risk_cents,
    cc.last_campaign_at
   FROM ((client_cycles cc
     JOIN clients c ON (((c.id = cc.client_id) AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL))))
     JOIN services s ON ((s.id = cc.service_id)))
  WHERE (cc.state = ANY (ARRAY['due'::cycle_state, 'late'::cycle_state, 'at_risk'::cycle_state, 'lost'::cycle_state]))
  ORDER BY cc.value_at_risk_cents DESC;

views.name: v_daily_cash
views.def:
SELECT tenant_id,
    date_trunc('day'::text, closed_at) AS day,
    count(*) AS tickets,
    sum(total_cents) AS revenue_cents,
    sum(material_cost_cents) AS material_cents,
    sum(fee_cents) AS fee_cents,
    sum(commission_cents) AS commission_cents,
    sum(profit_cents) AS profit_cents
   FROM tickets t
  WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['closed'::ticket_status, 'paid'::ticket_status]))
  GROUP BY tenant_id, (date_trunc('day'::text, closed_at));
